## Checklist

- [ ] `bun install`, `bun test`, `bun run build`, and `bun scripts/quality-gate.ts` all pass locally.
- [ ] Tests cover the new behavior or bug fix.
- [ ] `bun scripts/gen-manifest.ts` was run and the regenerated manifest is committed (if modules changed).
- [ ] Pseudocode, frame descriptions, and complexity are present and accurate for any new or changed module.
- [ ] New or changed text is American English, with no mojibake or TODOs.
- [ ] No unrelated files, generated build output, or secrets are included.
- [ ] The PR description explains the change and links any related issue.
